laws.rule: Since 1 October 2025 Heidelberg charges an overnight stay tax of EUR 3.50 per person per night (about A$5.56, RBA rate of 30 October 2026), business stays included, for up to five nights in a row at the same place; under-16s are exempt.
laws.heading: Übernachtungsteuersatzung Heidelberg (2025)

laws.rule: Black Forest National Park: stay on the signed paths and check the park's map for seasonal path closures. Dogs must be on a lead. Overnight stays in the park are generally not allowed, with or without a tent; multi-day hikers can book sites through the trekking-schwarzwald.de system. No fire and no smoking; collecting wood and felling trees are prohibited. Don't enter or use the streams, rivers and lakes (no bathing, diving, wading or floats). Park only in marked areas; driving on the park's paths is not allowed. Guided tours and organised walking events inside the park need the park's approval.
